violations.description: Multiple OSCEs lack appropriate radiology imaging types. ENDO-OSCE-0001/0002 specify 'Thyroid_Function_Tests' (lab values, not imaging), ENDO-OSCE-0003 'ABG_Glucose' (lab, not imaging), ENDO-OSCE-0004 'Glucose_Chart' (not imaging), ENDO-OSCE-0005 'Neurological_Exam' (clinical exam, not imaging), ENDO-OSCE-0007 'Cortisol_Tests' (lab), ENDO-OSCE-0008 'Hormone_Levels' (lab), CARD-OSCE-0010 'Assessment_Form' (not imaging), CARD-OSCE-0011 'Tilt_Table_Test' (procedure, not static image), CARD-OSCE-0014 'BP_Chart' (vital signs, not imaging), CARD-OSCE-0015 'Carotid_Massage' (procedure), GAST-OSCE-0032/0037 'Abdominal_Xray' (appropriate but misspelled - should be 'Abdominal X-ray' per Australian standards), GENE-OSCE-0023 'ESR_CRP' (lab values), GENE-OSCE-0024 'Blood_Film' (microscopy, not radiological imaging), GENE-OSCE-0025 'Blood_Culture' (lab), GENE-OSCE-0026 'Temperature_Chart' (vital signs), GENE-OSCE-0029 'Investigation_Flow' (algorithm, not imaging), GENE-OSCE-0030 'Laboratory' (lab, not imaging), GENE-OSCE-0031 'Toxicology_Screen' (lab), GAST-OSCE-0039-0044 'Electrolyte_Panel', 'Calcium_Level' (labs, not imaging), GAST-OSCE-0045 'Clinical_Assessment' (not imaging), GAST-OSCE-0046 'Bristol_Stool_Chart' (classification tool, not imaging), NEUR-OSCE-0047 'Dix_Hallpike' (clinical maneuver), NEUR-OSCE-0050 'EEG' (neurophysiology, not radiology), NEUR-OSCE-0051 'Nerve_Conduction' (neurophysiology), NEUR-OSCE-0052 'MMSE_Form' (cognitive assessment)

Content provides scenario templates without actual images or interpretation examples. Cannot assess if ABCDE (CXR), 7-step ECG, or ABC (CT) systematic approaches are used. 26 of 52 OSCEs specify non-radiological assessments, making systematic radiological interpretation impossible

Multiple OSCEs use 'Abdominal_Xray' (GAST-OSCE-0032, GAST-OSCE-0037) instead of Australian standard 'Abdominal X-ray' or 'AXR'. File path naming convention uses underscores rather than proper medical terminology
No technical adequacy criteria specified for any OSCE. Missing: rotation assessment, inspiration adequacy (6 anterior/10 posterior ribs for CXR), penetration, PA vs AP projection documentation

26 of 52 OSCEs (50%) require non-radiology expertise: Endocrine labs (ENDO-OSCE-0001/2/3/4/7/8), procedural assessments (CARD-OSCE-0011/0015, NEUR-OSCE-0047), laboratory medicine (GENE-OSCE-0023/24/25/31, GAST-OSCE-0039-0044), neurophysiology (NEUR-OSCE-0050/0051), cognitive assessment (NEUR-OSCE-0052)

References lack specific radiological content validation. ENDO-OSCE-0001 cites 'John Murtagh General Practice' p.731 with confidence 0.776 but no content preview to verify imaging interpretation guidance. Cannot verify if citations support systematic radiological interpretation

suggestions: Replace non-imaging assessments with appropriate radiological images (e.g., ENDO-OSCE-0001/0002: replace 'Thyroid_Function_Tests' with 'Thyroid Ultrasound' or 'Thyroid Scintigraphy')
Add technical adequacy assessment criteria for all imaging OSCEs (rotation, inspiration, penetration for CXR; calibration for ECG; window settings for CT)
Standardize terminology: 'Abdominal X-ray' or 'AXR' (not 'Abdominal_Xray'), 'Chest X-ray' or 'CXR' (not 'CXR' in file paths with underscores)
Provide actual image examples or detailed systematic interpretation frameworks in each OSCE scenario
Separate radiology OSCEs from laboratory medicine/clinical examination OSCEs - create dedicated pathology/clinical skills expert evaluations
Add RANZCR Imaging Pathways appropriateness criteria references for each imaging modality
Include critical findings checklists for each imaging type (e.g., tension pneumothorax for CXR, STEMI criteria for ECG, midline shift >5mm for CT head)
Specify PA vs AP projection for all CXR OSCEs (affects CTR interpretation)
Add comparative imaging requirements where clinically relevant (e.g., 'compare to previous CXR dated...')
